population: Invented active salaried workforce, separate from every recorded-data cohort and public wage reference.
compaRatio: 100 * sum(annual contracted base pay / FTE) / sum(matching annual full-time base-pay range midpoint)
distribution: Equal-person descriptive statistics of annual contracted base pay / FTE; population SD divides by eligible N; quartiles use linear interpolation at (N-1)*p.
disclosure: Release only fixed disjoint job-level-location cells. Withhold every measure for eligible N<5, then suppress one additional cell when a job-level partition has exactly one suppressed location. No totals, marginals, arbitrary bins, time comparisons or row records are published. Counts of 1-4 excluded records and their total/coverage denominator are withheld.
interpretation: Designed demonstration only. Midpoints and location multipliers are invented, not BLS estimates, employer pay policy, market premiums, pay-equity findings or individual rankings. No normality assumption. Suppression is a demonstration disclosure rule, not a general privacy guarantee.
